primary_question: Which left-front MaleCNS proximal motor populations have sufficient anatomical and frozen external mechanical evidence to be explicit candidates for a later causal neural-to-physical mapping experiment?

activity_survey_freeze.availability_note: Freeze index and aggregate summary are tracked; hashed per-population report is absent from this checkout.

classification_rules_preregistered_befor.BLOCKED_BY_IDENTITY_AMBIGUITY: Use when annotation does not uniquely identify the relevant MaleCNS muscle class or competing identities cannot be separated. Historical mapping cannot resolve it.
classification_rules_preregistered_befor.BLOCKED_BY_MECHANICAL_AMBIGUITY: Use when identity is adequate but no unambiguous, separately preserved frozen external tendon covector can be bound to the class.
classification_rules_preregistered_befor.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Use when neither a defensible identity-mechanics hypothesis nor a testable causal construct can be stated.
classification_rules_preregistered_befor.OBSERVED_SILENT_BUT_TESTABLE: Use when identity and mechanics support a causal construct and the exact frozen survey records zero spike increments; silence is condition-specific and does not imply nonfunction.
classification_rules_preregistered_befor.READY_FOR_CAUSAL_MAPPING_TEST: Use when identity and separately preserved external mechanics support a test and the frozen survey documents activity; this does not imply admission or biological truth.
classification_rules_preregistered_befor.READY_FOR_MECHANICAL_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY: Use when identity and external mechanics support a covector hypothesis but causal readiness is not established, including unavailable per-population activity evidence.
anti_shortcuts: Historical mapping agreement alone never qualifies a candidate.
External FlyMimic mechanics alone never establishes neural function.
Neural silence alone never rejects an anatomically supported candidate.
Evidence layers must not be collapsed into a confidence score.

descriptive_group_definitions.SINGLE_COORDINATE_DOMINANT_REFERENCE: External reference with the strongest single-coordinate concentration among the seven frozen tendons; descriptive only. The sternal anterior rotator is the preserved finding (yaw absolute fraction 0.6861822911166087).
descriptive_group_definitions.MULTI_DOF_REFERENCE: External reference whose complete three-component covector must be retained; dominant-component reduction is prohibited.
descriptive_group_definitions.IDENTITY_OR_MECHANICS_BLOCKED: Candidate classified with an identity or mechanics blocker.
descriptive_group_definitions.SURVEY_SILENT: Candidate explicitly recorded silent by available per-population frozen evidence; none assigned because that report is unavailable here.
descriptive_group_definitions.no_ranking: Groups are not scores, rankings, biological superiority, or interface-readiness judgments.

minimum_design: Freeze and checksum the implementation/preregistration before execution.
Preserve the existing MaleCNS neural runtime and sensory input.
Branch candidate ENABLED and candidate ZEROED only at the final physical application boundary.
Where technically possible, replay/copy identical neural state and sensory history into paired conditions.
Log population spikes and rates independently of the candidate physical contribution.
Apply and log all three proximal components; do not select a dominant coordinate.
Log requested contribution and realized physical response so neural silence and zero physical effect remain distinguishable.
Use no hidden controller, gait generator, stabilization, balance/righting logic, scripted locomotion, perturbation, or force beyond the preregistered candidate boundary.
Do not interpret movement as natural biological function.

paired_conditions.ENABLED: Candidate boundary receives the preregistered decoder output, whose vector and gain must be preregistered separately before execution.
paired_conditions.ZEROED: Same candidate boundary is explicitly zero while all admitted channels remain identical.
paired_conditions.neural_state_requirement: IDENTICAL_WHERE_TECHNICALLY_POSSIBLE; otherwise preregister the mismatch and pairing method before execution.

NEURAL_ACTIVITY_PRESENT.metric: population spike increments and population rate under the future paired trial
NEURAL_ACTIVITY_PRESENT.criterion: Nonzero prespecified activity in the analysis window

PHYSICAL_CONTRIBUTION_NONZERO.metric: logged three-component candidate contribution at final application boundary
PHYSICAL_CONTRIBUTION_NONZERO.criterion: At least one component exceeds a predeclared numerical/noise tolerance

ENABLED_ZEROED_DIVERGENCE_PRESENT.metric: paired three-component proximal physical outcome difference
ENABLED_ZEROED_DIVERGENCE_PRESENT.criterion: Difference exceeds a predeclared numerical/noise tolerance over a predeclared window

DIRECTION_CONSISTENT_WITH_HYPOTHESIS.metric: directional agreement between paired physical difference and preregistered H_population
DIRECTION_CONSISTENT_WITH_HYPOTHESIS.criterion: Predeclared vector-direction test passes; external sign cannot supply decoder activation sign

MULTI_DOF_RATIO_CONSISTENT_WITH_REFERENC.metric: ratios of all estimable three-component enabled-zeroed effects versus the selected external reference covector
MULTI_DOF_RATIO_CONSISTENT_WITH_REFERENC.criterion: Predeclared ratio/vector similarity test and tolerance pass without dominant-axis reduction

future_decision_gates.multiple_tendon_rule: For the broad promotor population, select one tendon-specific hypothesis or preregister a biologically justified combination rule before execution; no post-hoc averaging or best-fit tendon selection.

unresolved_blockers: Per-population frozen survey report is absent from this checkout, preventing faithful active/silent and spike/rate extraction.
MaleCNS-to-FlyGym activation/coordinate signs require independent validation for every candidate.
Decoder vectors and gains remain UNASSIGNED.
Transfer from FlyMimic tendon mechanics to MaleCNS population action is unvalidated.
Local differential evidence does not establish finite-angle or pose-independent behavior.
Broad tergopleural/pleural promotor annotation binds to three distinct external tendons; selection or combination must be independently preregistered.
scientific_limitations: Candidate status is not interface admission.
No claim of biological ground truth, natural function, necessity, sufficiency, locomotion, gait, balance, stabilization, or righting is made.
No confidence score or overall candidate ranking is produced.
The historical logical action, joint, and sign are metadata only and were excluded from qualification.
